job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is an Indiana Public Retirement System RFP for core plus fixed income investment management, not KCERA’s audit-services RFP. Its five-year initial term and renewal option do not support the requested KCERA contract terms.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”) for CORE PLUS FIXED INCOME INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT
INPRS is issuing this RFP in accordance with Indiana statutes governing the procurement of services and certain administrative policies of INPRS.
The term of the contract entered under this RFP shall be for an initial period of five (5) years, beginning from the date of final execution of contract.
There may be one (1) or more renewals under the same terms and conditions at INPRS’ option up to the length of the original term.
